text: In previous generations, it was common for grandparents to live with or near their children and to take an active part in raising their grandchildren. Today, this role has become much more limited in many societies. This essay will explain the reasons for this change and argue that, on balance, it is a negative development for children and families.

The main reason for this shift is the way families now live. Many young people move to large cities or even abroad in search of work and education, and they often end up hundreds of kilometres away from their own parents. In addition, grandparents themselves are leading more active lives than before. Because people are staying healthy and working until a later age, many grandparents are still employed or have their own interests and simply have less time to look after young children. As a result, working parents increasingly rely on nurseries and paid babysitters instead.

In my view, this development is largely negative. Grandparents can offer children a kind of patient, unconditional attention that busy parents and professional carers often cannot, and they pass on family history, language and traditions that might otherwise be lost. This is particularly important in countries such as Kazakhstan, where family customs and the native language are often learned at home. Moreover, childcare provided by relatives is free and flexible, which reduces financial pressure on young parents.

In conclusion, grandparents are less involved in childcare mainly because families live further apart and older people are busier than in the past. Although this gives grandparents more freedom, I believe children lose an important source of care and cultural knowledge, so families should look for ways to keep the generations connected, even at a distance.

strengths.en: Each question gets its own paragraph, so the examiner can see at once that the task is fully answered.
strengths.kk: Тапсырманың әр сұрағына — жеке абзац, сондықтан емтихан алушы жауаптың толық екенін бірден көреді.
strengths.ru: Каждому вопросу задания — свой абзац, поэтому экзаменатор сразу видит, что ответ полный.
strengths.example: The main reason for this shift is the way families now live

strengths.en: The reasons are linked and lead to a shared result — Coherence and Cohesion at band 8.
strengths.kk: Себептер өзара байланысып, ортақ салдарға әкеледі — бұл Coherence and Cohesion band 8.
strengths.ru: Причины связаны между собой и приводят к общему следствию — это Coherence and Cohesion band 8.
strengths.example: As a result, working parents increasingly rely on nurseries and paid babysitters instead

strengths.en: The task asks for examples from your own experience, and a Kazakh example makes the point vivid and concrete.
strengths.kk: Тапсырмада өз тәжірибеңізден мысал сұралады — Қазақстаннан алынған мысал дәлелді тірі әрі нақты етеді.
strengths.ru: В задании просят примеры из своего опыта — пример из Казахстана делает довод живым и конкретным.
strengths.example: in countries such as Kazakhstan, where family customs and the native language are often learned at home

strengths.en: The position is firm, but the writer also admits a benefit, which sounds mature and convincing.
strengths.kk: Ұстаным берік, бірақ автор өзгерістің жақсы жағын да мойындайды — бұл парасатты әрі сенімді естіледі.
strengths.ru: Позиция твёрдая, но автор признаёт и плюс перемен — это звучит зрело и убедительно.
strengths.example: Although this gives grandparents more freedom

note.en: Introduction: the change in the writer’s own words and the plan — reasons, then the verdict “mostly negative”.
note.kk: Кіріспе: өзгеріс өз сөзімен және жоспар — себептер, сосын баға «көбіне жағымсыз».
note.ru: Введение: изменение своими словами и план — причины, затем оценка «скорее негативно».

note.en: Answer to the first question, “why”: two reasons — families moving away and grandparents’ own busier lives.
note.kk: Бірінші «неге» сұрағына жауап: екі себеп — отбасылардың көшуі және атасы мен әжесінің белсенді өмірі.
note.ru: Ответ на первый вопрос «почему»: две причины — переезды семей и более активная жизнь самих бабушек и дедушек.

note.en: Answer to the second question: a “negative” position with three points, one illustrated with Kazakhstan.
note.kk: Екінші сұраққа жауап: «жағымсыз» ұстанымы үш дәлелмен, біреуі — Қазақстаннан мысал.
note.ru: Ответ на второй вопрос: позиция «негативно» с тремя доводами, один из них — пример из Казахстана.

note.en: The conclusion answers both questions and admits one benefit of the change.
note.kk: Қорытынды екі сұраққа да жауап береді және өзгерістің бір жақсы жағын мойындайды.
note.ru: Вывод отвечает на оба вопроса и признаёт одну сильную сторону перемены.
